items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: And quite a bit with, with, with Condon when they first came to New York.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did Glenn Miller play any jazz at that time? Oh, yeah. Glenn played a lot of jazz. Uh-huh. Glenn played some things with, uh, with the, he made some records with the Mount City Booblowers. I remember that. And quite a bit with, with, with Condon when they first came to New York. And with, uh, with Nichols.
What was Glenn Miller's, uh, what was Glenn Miller's, uh, aspiration at that time? Did he want to continue to be a jazz trombone player? Did he want to write even in those days?
